data.validation_assumption: B; lower10% S,V and upper30% N,S,V,F; C not applied
data.model_choice_inputs: DS1 train and fixed validation only; DS2 labels/metadata audit allowed, predictions only after model lock
data.preprocessing: Unchanged MLII by name;114 index1;360 samples [R-180,R+180);drop incomplete boundaries;global train-only normalization;5 outputs

metrics.confusion: 5x5 on all true samples and argmax over all five outputs, rows true/columns predicted; never remove Q samples
metrics.per_class: TP=Ckk; FP=sum_i Cik-TP; FN=sum_j Ckj-TP; F1=2TP/(2TP+FP+FN), zero denominator yields0
metrics.K: Fixed from true validation support before training; supported subset of N,S,V,F only; never recompute from predictions or change per epoch/seed/run
metrics.report: Both macro metrics named explicitly; per-class support, precision, recall, confusion and accuracy; record Q support and model limitation

baseline_candidate.model: Existing mitdb_baseline_model.py,109653 parameters; no architecture/RR/contract changes
baseline_candidate.sampler: shuffle train only, no weighted sampler

class_weights.source: Only accepted train counts after fixed validation split

finite_trial_budget.advance_trigger: Only if current trial has no deployment candidate passing all N,V,S gates; stop adjustments at first passing trial or after T2
finite_trial_budget.trial_log: Pre-register all9 slots with protocol/data hashes before any training; record executed/skipped trigger, every epoch, checkpoint, metrics, seed, retry and failure; never delete unsuccessful trials
finite_trial_budget.allowed_changes: Only predeclared cap/lr sequence; weights stay inverse frequency with cap, same data/model/seeds; sampler and split are not in search space

baseline_candidate.deployment_seed_selection: Within first fully completed trial having all-gate-eligible seeds, choose largest fixed-K validation macro-F1; tie smaller numeric seed; checkpoint tie earlier epoch; all3 seeds reported including ineligible ones
baseline_candidate.technical_failure_policy: Retry same slot/seed once retaining original attempt; second technical failure blocks trial completion and A lock, no seed replacement or 2-seed mean

validation_gates.checkpoint: deployment checkpoint on whole fixed validation

S_only_exception.eligibility: All three predeclared trials exhausted and logged; all3 seeds completed for usable trial; candidate passes N and V but fails only S
S_only_exception.selection: Among N/V-passing candidates across completed trials choose highest fixed-K macro-F1; tie earlier trial then smaller seed
S_only_exception.basis: Approved locked protocol including this clause, or separate recorded owner/reviewer decision; record attempts, S counts/errors and no-RR limitation; never waive V or lower thresholds silently
S_only_exception.report: S failure disclosed; not evidence of minority-class adequacy or clinical performance

nopeek_candidate.initialization: Every run/seed uses the exact deployment checkpoint of locked A, not the baseline checkpoint of that seed
nopeek_candidate.baseline_reference: macro-F1 of the deployment checkpoint A on fixed validation K, not the mean of three baseline seeds

epoch0.check: whole-validation confusion and accuracy/macro-F1 reproduce A exactly on declared runtime; subset dCor and source/checkpoint hashes recorded; mismatch blocks run before updates

nopeek_candidate.train_scope: joint head+tail for grid; separate extension tail fine-tune later, no flash-driven freeze of head
nopeek_candidate.loss: weighted train CE using deployment A trial train-only class weights + lambda*existing biased sample dCor Rn; per-batch loss dCor distinct from fixed-subset evaluation
nopeek_candidate.scheduler: none for fixed-epoch grid; pilot may motivate a new protocol revision before grid

pilot.selection: Compare lambda0 fixed-K macro-F1 after including epoch0; choose LR with highest mean across3 splits, tie smallerLR; use positive-lambda runs diagnostically; save all pilot runs; freeze selectedLR in new version before grid

nopeek_candidate.lambda0_checkpoint: Maximum fixed-K validation macro-F1 among epoch0..20; ties earliest; epoch0 remains eligible and must equal A
nopeek_candidate.positive_lambda_checkpoint: Only epochs1..20; filter macro-F1>=0.95*A macro-F1, choose lowest fixed-subset dCor; tie larger macro-F1 then earliest epoch
nopeek_candidate.positive_lambda_fallback: If no epoch1..20 passes utility, choose maximum macro-F1 among epochs1..20, tie earliest; record fallback=true, utility_pass=false; never silently select epoch0

fixed_dcor_validation_subset.input: only fixed validation metadata, no predicted labels or DS2
fixed_dcor_validation_subset.selection: SHA256 ASCII(domain|seed|patient_id|record_id|r_peak_sample|original_symbol|lead_name); rank by digest then validation row index; take first512, record ordered row IDs and SHA before train; fail if fewer than512
fixed_dcor_validation_subset.evaluation: one unpartitioned biased-sample Rn over same512 rows in eval mode, same order/batch definition for all runs and epoch0; never change sample count per run

collapse.definition: any predicted class count / N_val >=0.99 OR recall_V<0.10
collapse.evaluated_at: selected checkpoint after reload, including fallback; all-epoch diagnostics also saved
collapse.effect: keep run values in mean/SD and plots; any collapsed seed makes lambda INELIGIBLE_UNSTABLE

technical_failure.retry: exact same seed/config/source/checkpoint once; retain both attempts
technical_failure.repeated_failure: failed run, lambda INELIGIBLE_INCOMPLETE; mean/SD null instead of computing over2 seeds

statistics.mean: arithmetic mean over all3 completed selected checkpoints, including collapsed and utility fallback runs
statistics.report: every seed and selected epoch; all54 run slots including technical failure/collapse/retry; no seed replacement

lambda_utility_alternatives.each_seed: all3 selected-checkpoint macro-F1>=0.95*A; implies mean rule, converse not true

nopeek_candidate.lambda_selection: After final utility aggregation rule is locked, among complete noncollapsed utility-eligible lambdas for each split minimize mean fixed-subset dCor; tie smallerlambda; never use DS2

extension_tail_acceptance.scope: controller-authorized (s,rho), at selectedlambda, separate extension/fine-tune stage
extension_tail_acceptance.two_conditions: accuracy validation >= A accuracy -0.02 AND fixed-K macro-F1 validation>=0.95*A macro-F1
extension_tail_acceptance.remediation: fine-tune tail with DS1 only, then next smaller predeclaredlambda if still fails; log versions/attempt budget before extension
extension_tail_acceptance.teacher_metric_issue: Khung accuracy>=95% baseline vs macro-F1 rule needs teacher resolution; report both; no claim equivalent

figures.curves: macro-F1 and dCor vs lambda, A baseline and always-N baseline, all3 seeds and mean/sampleSD

deployment_and_handoff.package_A: Locked baseline checkpoint/header generated with existing format; unchanged architecture/tensor assertions; normalization+split+processed SHA; golden s0-s9 from train/val calibration only; FP32 and INT8/FP16 predictions after lock; README+full SHA
deployment_and_handoff.package_B: Per-s selected NoPeek checkpoints, protection parameters, validation/selection records and offline evaluation after lock; not a replacement baseline A
deployment_and_handoff.baseline_install: A weights replacement week13 once per device; owner build/VERIFY/G2 required
deployment_and_handoff.additional_heads_install: SV1 proposal: add B heads once in week14 image, VERIFY and registry; distinct from replacing A; not approved or performed now
deployment_and_handoff.identity_invariant: Head and tail derived from same full checkpoint/model and its normalization/data revision. Protection mode must bind matching parameters/compiled tail. Reject mixed baseline/NoPeek head-tail even when shapes match.
deployment_and_handoff.P0_P1: Use A model with declared protection mode; P1 bit-exact inverse does not change model identity
deployment_and_handoff.P2: Use selected B(s) full model, corresponding head<=s and matching tail, plus per-(s,rho) learned noise/protection parameters; rho numeric mapping pending joint contract

protocol_change_control.now: Candidate only; no locked protocol claimed
protocol_change_control.within_locked_policy: Predeclared ordered T0/T1/T2 adjustments on DS1 validation are authorized by that locked policy once reviewed; retain all trial slots and results
protocol_change_control.outside_locked_policy: Never edit the locked file. Stop dependent experiments; propose a new version with reason/diff, exact old/new hashes and required review/approval before new trials. Preserve all previous trial evidence.
protocol_change_control.pilot_to_grid: Selected LR and any change become a new version before grid approval; pilot results never silently rewrite the locked pilot policy
protocol_change_control.DS2: No DS2 predictions for tuning or protocol revision; evaluate only after final model lock
